precision: Unquantized BF16/FP32 mathematical references. No FP4, FP8 QAT, distributed collectives or model projections.

mla_implementation.role: Implementation guidance for custom MLA kernels.
mla_implementation.scope: Current MLA remains dense absorbed C512/R64 (QK=576,V=512). Study split-KV, BF16 MMA, asynchronous staging, warp specialization and shared-memory budgeting; adapt tile sizes for SM89 rather than copying A100 assumptions. The fork's sparse V4 D512 V=K and quantized caches are different contracts, not replacements for current MLA. No fork kernel has been ported by this source-registration change.

hca_csa.contract: Compressor, Indexer and Attention equations; independent implementation. HCA ratio128, CSA ratio4 overlap, sink, partial RoPE/inverse output RoPE. Supplied angle table supports the model's YaRN policy. Index keys are separate from attention KV. Orthogonal index rotation may be omitted only with quantization disabled.

dsa.contract: Prepared lightning-indexer inputs, weighted ReLU score, causal topk, sparse absorbed-query MLA. No gradient through discrete topk; indexer scores are differentiable separately.

moe.contract: V3 sigmoid routing with selection bias, optional group limiting, no capacity drops, SwiGLU experts. The native grouped comparison measures only packed GEMMs, not routing/dispatch.

kda.contract: Independent recurrent oracle plus official FLA chunk forward/backward, prepared normalized q/k and activated log-decay/beta. FP32 final state in key-first layout.

flashmla.contract: Official deepseek-ai/FlashMLA benchmark reference. The MLA runner supports its BF16 paged dense decode on SM90; custom/PyTorch output casts to BF16 are included in timing, while cache packing is outside timing. The default PyTorch comparison retains FP32 outputs and prefill/backward coverage. Sparse prefill remains a separate adapter; H100 execution is not verified on SM89.

deepgemm.contract: Optional masked M-grouped BF16 GEMM with BF16 output. Only valid expert rows are defined; H100 execution is not verified on SM89.
